blocks.title: Network topology
blocks.text: Network topology computer network ka naqsha (layout) hai: devices aur cables kaise tarteeb diye gaye hain. Physical topology asal connections dikhati hai; logical topology dikhati hai ke network mein data kaise behta hai.
Topology network ki karkardagi aur dekh-bhaal par asar dalti hai. Paanch aam topologies bus, star, ring, mesh aur tree hain (Figs 1.8 se 1.12).

items: Bus: tamam devices aik hi main cable se jure hote hain, jis ke dono siron par terminator hota hai; data cable ke saath har device tak jata hai. Yeh saada aur sasta aur chhote networks ke liye munasib hai, lekin main cable ki kharabi poora network rok deti hai, is liye bare networks ke liye achha nahi.

Star: tamam devices darmiyani hub ya switch se jurte hain, aur data darmiyani device se guzarta hai. Ise sambhalna aur barhana asan hai, aur aik device ki kharabi doosron par asar nahi karti, lekin darmiyani device ki kharabi network rok deti hai. Jadeed networks mein yeh aam hai.

Ring: devices gol raste mein jure hote hain aur data ring mein aik simt mein chalta hai, har device data le kar aage bhejta hai. Aik device ki kharabi poore network par asar kar sakti hai; yeh bus se zyada pecheeda aur aaj kal kam use hoti hai.

Mesh: har device bohat se doosre devices se jura hota hai, is liye data ke kai raste hote hain. Agar aik link toot jaye to data doosra rasta leta hai, jis se network qabil-e-aitbaar aur fault-tolerant hota hai, lekin yeh mehnga aur pecheeda hai. Bare aur ahem networks mein use hoti hai.

Tree: devices darakht ki tarah darja-ba-darja (hierarchy) tarteeb mein hote hain. Yeh bus aur star ko milati hai: kai star networks aik darmiyani backbone se jure hote hain, aur data jar (root, main node) se shaakhon aur choti shaakhon tak behta hai. Bare networks ke liye barhana aur sambhalna asan hai, lekin backbone ki kharabi poore network par asar kar sakti hai. Bare idaron mein aam hai.

blocks.alt: Teen panels. Bus: chaar computers aik lambi main cable se chhoti lines par, dono siron par narangi terminator; note: sasta, saada, cable ki kharabi sab rok deti. Star: paanch computers har aik apni line se darmiyani hub ya switch se jura; note: sambhalna asan, aik device akela kharab, hub sab ko rok deta. Ring: daire par paanch computers, surkh teer aik simt dikhata; note: har device data aage bhejta, aik kharabi ring torti.
blocks.caption: Bus, star aur ring topologies (Figs 1.8 se 1.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Bus mein har device aik cable share karta hai; star mein har device ka markaz tak apna link hai; ring mein har device data agle ko deta hai.

blocks.alt: Do panels. Mesh: panch-gosha par paanch computers, har computer har doosre se line se jura; note: kai raste, aik link toote to data doosra rasta, qabil-e-aitbaar magar mehnga aur pecheeda. Tree: amudi backbone cable ke oopar server; backbone se do switches nikalte, har aik ke neeche teen computers; note: star networks aik backbone se jure, barhana asan, backbone ki kharabi sab par asar.
blocks.caption: Mesh aur tree topologies (Figs 1.11 aur 1.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: n devices wale poore mesh ko n(n-1)/2 links chahiye (paanch devices ke liye 10), isi liye yeh qabil-e-aitbaar magar mehnga hai. Tree backbone par star networks jor kar barhta hai.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Talaba daire mein khare ho kar paigham aage barhayein; guftagu karein ke agar aik talib-e-ilm ruk jaye to kya hota hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Kuch topologies saada aur sasti hain; kuch qabil-e-aitbaar magar mehngi. Kuch barhane mein asan aur kuch sambhalne mein mushkil hain. Intikhab network ki zaroorat par munhasir hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si topology darmiyani hub ya switch use karti hai, aur kaun si sab se zyada qabil-e-aitbaar hai? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Star darmiyani hub ya switch use karti hai. Mesh sab se zyada qabil-e-aitbaar hai, kyunke har device ke kai raste hain, is liye data kharab link ke gird se ja sakta hai.

items: Topology: devices aur cables ka naqsha; physical ya logical.
Bus (aik cable), star (darmiyani switch), ring (daira), mesh (kai raste), tree (backbone par stars).
Intikhab qeemat, aitbaar, barhane aur sambhalne ki asani par.
